title: SLO narrative heatmap + escalation matrix for initiative tracking
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Define and deliver a narrative-first SLO initiative tracker: a heatmap that surfaces active SLOs, their narrative status (why it matters), error-budget burn trends, and a clear escalation matrix for when burn crosses thresholds. Integrate view into Redwood Console and provide a weekly export for executive OKR reviews.
problem_statement: Existing SLO dashboards at Redwood show numbers but lack context. Engineers and PMs struggle to understand the customer impact behind burn spikes, and escalation rules live in a separate doc. This limits fast, aligned decisions during degradation and reduces the quality of quarterly reliability narratives used for OKRs.
proposed_solution: Ship a combined SLO Narrative Heatmap and Escalation Matrix: 1) Heatmap rows = SLOs (product + infra), columns = cadence windows (24h, 7d, 30d) with color-coded burn and a one-line narrative field attached. 2) Escalation matrix with automated notifications when budget thresholds hit (50% / 75% / 100%) and suggested mitigation playbooks per SLO. 3) Exportable weekly digest for PM leads and execs and a Console panel for on-call and SRE teams.
milestones: M1: Draft schema for narrative fields and heatmap visualization - due 2026-03-04
M2: Console panel prototype (read-only) and backend API for narrative metadata - due 2026-03-18
M3: Escalation rules engine + notification hooks to PagerDuty/Slack - due 2026-03-28
M4: Beta release to SRE + two product teams, collect feedback - due 2026-04-04
M5: Finalize export and OKR digest; ship GA - due 2026-04-08
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap shows all active SLOs with 24h/7d/30d burn colors and displays the narrative text inline
Console panel reads narrative metadata and links to runbooks; accessible to Pager role
Escalation matrix triggers notifications at configured thresholds and includes suggested mitigations
Weekly digest export contains per-initiative narrative summaries and will be consumed by PM leads
Documentation with runbook links and owner fields exists and has signoff from SRE and Product
updates: 2026-02-25: Created ticket and aligned concept with SRE and Product. Decision: narrative field is free-form text (max 280 chars) with optional structured tags.
2026-03-01: Design walkthrough with Design (Maya Russo). Feedback: heatmap must show owner and recent deploy tag to help triage suspicion of release-related spikes.
2026-03-05: Engineering spike completed by ENG infra team. Trade-off: live aggregation for 24h window will use approximate sampling to avoid heavy reads. Agreed to add sampling accuracy note in UI.
2026-03-09: PM review: request to add 'OKR alignment' checkbox per SLO to surface which SLOs feed critical objectives. Added to M2 scope.
2026-03-12: Security review requested for export functionality. Security review flag set; scope reduced for beta to internal-only exports.
